stories.headline: DeepSeek begins IPO preparations, reports annualized revenue nearing $500M

key_facts.fact: DeepSeek has begun preparations for an initial public offering, working with accounting firms and banks to file a listing application on the mainland Chinese stock market as soon as end-2026, targeting a 2027 debut.
key_facts.excerpt: DeepSeek is currently in discussions with listing advisors, including accounting firms and investment banks... DeepSeek plans to submit its listing application at the end of this year or in early 2027.

key_facts.fact: DeepSeek's annualized revenue run rate has reached $400M-$500M, roughly double the $200M-$220M estimated in 2025.
key_facts.excerpt: DeepSeek... has reportedly reached an annualized revenue run rate between $400 million and $500 million. That's roughly double the $200 million to $220 million estimates that circulated in 2025.

key_facts.fact: Weeks after closing a ~$7B round at a ~$50B valuation in early June, DeepSeek began talks this week for a fresh round seeking at least 10 billion yuan (~$1.5B) at a ~$71B pre-money valuation.
key_facts.excerpt: it also looks to raise around $1.5 billion in new funds at about a $71 billion valuation... after the company raised $7 billion in funds just a month ago at around a $50 billion valuation.

key_facts.fact: Founder Liang Wenfeng told investors DeepSeek will prioritize groundbreaking AI research and continue developing open-source models over short-term commercialization.
key_facts.excerpt: Liang Wenfeng pledged in at least one meeting with investors to keep developing open-source AI models while pursuing the broader goal of achieving artificial general intelligence.

stories.headline: Google releases DiffusionGemma, an open text-diffusion model up to 4x faster than standard LLMs

key_facts.fact: Google released DiffusionGemma, an experimental open model under an Apache 2.0 license: a 26B Mixture-of-Experts that generates blocks of text in parallel via diffusion instead of token-by-token, delivering up to 4x faster generation on GPUs.
key_facts.excerpt: Introducing DiffusionGemma, an experimental open model that explores text diffusion... Released under an Apache 2.0 license, this 26B Mixture of Experts (MoE) model... delivering up to 4x faster text generation on GPUs.

key_facts.fact: The model reaches 1000+ tokens/sec on a single NVIDIA H100 and 700+ tokens/sec on an RTX 5090, activates only 3.8B parameters during inference, and fits within 18GB VRAM when quantized.
key_facts.excerpt: generates up to 4x faster token output on dedicated GPUs. (1000+ tokens per second on a single NVIDIA H100, 700+ tokens per second on NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090)... activates only 3.8B parameters during inference, DiffusionGemma fits comfortably within 18GB VRAM.

key_facts.fact: Weights are available on Hugging Face; Google notes output quality is lower than standard Gemma 4 and positions the model for local, low-concurrency workflows like in-line editing, code infilling and rapid iteration.
key_facts.excerpt: Access the experimental model weights (released under a permissive Apache 2.0 license) right now on Hugging Face... DiffusionGemma's overall output quality is lower than standard Gemma 4.

stories.headline: OpenAI researcher Miles Wang in talks to launch AI drug-discovery startup at ~$2B valuation

key_facts.fact: Miles Wang, an OpenAI researcher whose work includes using AI to accelerate scientific and biological discovery, is leaving to launch a startup building AI models for drug discovery, with several other OpenAI researchers expected to join.
key_facts.excerpt: Miles Wang, an OpenAI researcher whose work includes using AI to accelerate scientific and biological discovery, is leaving the ChatGPT maker to launch a new startup focused on developing AI models for drug discovery.

key_facts.fact: Wang is in talks to raise about $200M at a $2B valuation, with Lightspeed in discussions to lead; the startup may focus on finding new uses for FDA-approved drugs and compounds that previously failed in trials.
key_facts.excerpt: Wang is in talks to raise about $200 million at a $2 billion valuation... Lightspeed is in discussions to lead the funding round... Wang's new startup may be working on AI models that will help find new uses for existing drugs and possibly those that previously failed in trials.

key_facts.fact: The deal reflects surging investor interest in applying AI to life sciences: Chai Discovery announced a $400M raise at a $3.8B valuation the same week (July 14), and DeepMind spinout Isomorphic Labs raised a $2.1B Series B in May.
key_facts.excerpt: Chai Discovery... announced on Tuesday that it raised $400 million at a $3.8 billion valuation... Google DeepMind spinout Isomorphic Labs... raised a $2.1 billion Series B in May.

key_facts.fact: Wang disputed the $200M and $2B figures on the record while declining to provide corrected numbers; the deal is not final and terms could change.
key_facts.excerpt: Wang's on-the-record dispute of the $200 million and $2 billion figures is unusual... an active dispute suggests either the sourcing was wrong, the structure has changed since the reporting, or the company is trying to prevent specific numbers from becoming anchors.

stories.headline: xAI's Grok Build CLI caught uploading entire user repos; Musk pledges to delete all prior data

key_facts.fact: A security researcher (cereblab) demonstrated that xAI's Grok Build CLI v0.2.93 packaged users' entire tracked repositories, including full git history and committed secrets/.env files, and uploaded them as git bundles to a Google Cloud Storage bucket, roughly 27,800x more data than the coding task required.
key_facts.excerpt: xAI's Grok Build coding CLI was packaging developers' entire tracked repositories, including full Git history, committed secrets, and API keys, and sending them to a Google Cloud Storage bucket. The upload volume was roughly 27,800 times greater than the data the coding task actually required.

key_facts.fact: The upload occurred even when the agent was explicitly told not to open files, and the privacy opt-out toggle did not stop it; only gitignoring files or a server-side flag (disable_codebase_upload) prevented the transfer, contradicting xAI's 'local-first' marketing.
key_facts.excerpt: With the prompt literally 'reply OK, do not open any files,' Grok still uploads a git bundle of the whole repo... A permission deny stops the agent READING a file into the chat; it does NOT stop the whole-repo git-bundle upload.

key_facts.fact: On July 14 Elon Musk said on X that all user data uploaded before the change would be 'completely and utterly deleted,' and xAI deployed a server-side fix that stopped whole-repo uploads.
key_facts.excerpt: 'As a precautionary measure, all user data that was uploaded to SpaceXAI before now will be completely and utterly deleted,' he said... Cereblab confirmed that after the CLI's devs set disable_codebase_upload to 'true,' Grok Build stopped transmitting entire repos to its servers.

key_facts.fact: OpenAI's Sam Altman called the incident 'Concerning' and said it was 'a reason to favor open-source harnesses.'
key_facts.excerpt: also, a reason to favor open-source harnesses.

stories.headline: Anthropic launches Claude for Teachers, free premium access for US K-12 educators

key_facts.fact: Anthropic launched Claude for Teachers on July 14, giving verified US K-12 educators free access to premium Claude features; those who sign up by June 30, 2027 get a full year of access.
key_facts.excerpt: Once verified, educators can access Claude for Teachers entirely free. Sign up by June 30, 2027, for a full year of access.

key_facts.fact: The product includes a library of teaching skills and connectors to evidence-based curricula mapped to academic standards in all 50 states; Anthropic says models are never trained on educators' conversations.
key_facts.excerpt: Skills for teaching workflows; Connectors to evidence-based curriculum (including Learning Commons); Models are never trained on your conversations.

key_facts.fact: It will be piloted in the Detroit Public Schools Community District for a study on educator well-being and practice, joining Google (Gemini) and OpenAI in the race to bring AI into US classrooms.
key_facts.excerpt: It will also be piloted in Detroit Public Schools Community District for a study on educator well-being and practice... Claude for Teachers joins Google, OpenAI, and Khan Academy — among others — in marketing AI products specifically to K-12 educators.

stories.headline: OpenAI hits 8M users across Codex and ChatGPT Work as GPT-5.6 Sol demand surges

key_facts.fact: OpenAI reached 8M active users across Codex and ChatGPT Work and reset usage limits for all users to let them explore GPT-5.6 Sol, according to Codex lead Thibault Sottiaux on July 14.
key_facts.excerpt: Hello. We have reached 8M active users across Codex and ChatGPT Work. We are once again resetting the usage limits for all... allowing everyone to explore the boundaries of GPT-5.6 Sol.

key_facts.fact: Sam Altman said '5.6 sol growth is insane' and warned there could be 'some hiccups soon' as the inference team works to scale capacity to meet demand.
key_facts.excerpt: 5.6 sol growth is insane. the inference team has done heroic work to be able to support demand. we are going to move mountains to continue to scale, but it is possible there are some hiccups soon.

key_facts.fact: The 8M figure is up from 6M active users announced by Sottiaux roughly 24.5 hours earlier, prompting commentators to ask whether Codex had overtaken Anthropic's Claude Code.
key_facts.excerpt: Did... Codex just overtake Claude Code? 24.5 hours ago Tibo announced 6M active users.

stories.headline: InstaLILY raises $60M Series B for AI 'forward-deployed engineer' automating enterprise ops

key_facts.fact: InstaLILY closed a $60M Series B led by Energize Capital, bringing total funding to nearly $100M, with participation from Insight Partners and new strategic investors Home Depot Ventures and United Rentals.
key_facts.excerpt: closed on a hefty $60 million Series B round of funding that brings its total amount raised to date to almost $100 million... led by Energize Capital and saw participation from previous backer Insight Partners, as well as new investors like Home Depot Ventures and United Rentals.

key_facts.fact: The company launched 'Lily,' which it calls the world's first AI Forward Deployed Engineer, that learns a business's processes, builds and maintains custom software, and goes live in days; revenue grew 5x over the past year.
key_facts.excerpt: InstaLILY AI, creator of the world's first AI Forward Deployed Engineer, today announced a $60 million Series B round... The round brings the company's total raised to nearly $100 million, and revenue grew 5x over the past year.

key_facts.fact: At a national distributor, software Lily built generated over $200M in new annual sales, and at a field-service company it cut equipment diagnosis time from 15 minutes to under 10 seconds, reducing cost-to-serve by 98%.
key_facts.excerpt: At a national distributor, the software Lily built generated more than $200 million in new annual sales... at a field service company it cut diagnosis time from 15 minutes to under 10 seconds and reduced the cost to serve a call by 98 percent.
